Overview

Wrocław is a city in Lower Silesian with a population of 674,132. A beautiful city on the Oder River, known for its stunning Market Square, numerous bridges, colorful tenement houses, and a thriving tech and startup ecosystem. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
